defects.description: load() awaits each source before starting the next, so the three independent requests never overlap and the peak in-flight count stays at 1 instead of the 3 the contract promises.

trigger.input: import { DashboardLoader } from "./src/dashboard.js"; const monitor = { inFlight: 0, peak: 0 }; const panel = (value) => { monitor.inFlight += 1; if (monitor.inFlight > monitor.peak) monitor.peak = monitor.inFlight; return (async () => { await null; monitor.inFlight -= 1; return value; })(); }; const client = { profile: () => panel({ name: "ada" }), orders: () => panel([{ id: "o1" }]), activity: () => panel([{ kind: "login" }]) }; const dash = await new DashboardLoader(client).load(); console.log(JSON.stringify({ peak: monitor.peak, panels: Object.keys(dash).length }));

defects.why_missed: The suite asserts only the merged panels and that each source was asked once, never how many requests were in flight together, so serial awaits read as correct output.
